findings.label: Error boundary button missing focus ring
findings.detail: The 'Try again' button in src/app/(public)/error.tsx has no focus-visible:ring-* class. Keyboard users who land on the error page have no visible focus indicator on the only actionable element. Add focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-brand-primary focus-visible:ring-offset-2.

findings.label: Yellow badge WCAG AA contrast
findings.detail: bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 produces a contrast ratio near 4.5:1 at text-xs size — right at the WCAG AA threshold. The Resit badge on every PaperCard uses this combination. Verify with a contrast checker; if below 4.5:1 switch to text-yellow-900 or bg-yellow-200.

findings.label: SearchBar aria-label redundancy
findings.detail: The input has a connected <label> via htmlFor/id plus a duplicate aria-label and a redundant role='searchbox' on a native <input type='search'>. Screen readers may double-announce the label. Remove aria-label and role='searchbox' from the input.

findings.label: No automated tests
findings.detail: Zero test files exist. buildPages in Pagination.tsx and the URL-param update logic in SearchBar/FilterPanel are the highest-value targets. The absence leaves future refactors invisible to CI.
